items.h: Record warmth possible this week before heavier rain arrives
items.sum: Forecasts show unusually mild days in western Washington before a wetter weather system moves in.

items.h: Sound Transit says Crosslake Connection will be closed this weekend
items.sum: Sound Transit has scheduled a weekend closure of the Crosslake Connection.

items.h: Power restored in Capitol Hill after outage
items.sum: Electricity has been restored to the Capitol Hill area.

items.h: Car gets stuck on light rail track near Rainier Beach station
items.sum: A vehicle became stuck on the light rail tracks near the Rainier Beach station, the second such incident this year.

items.h: Proposed McDonald's in Chinatown draws debate
items.sum: Columnists weigh in on whether a proposed McDonald's would help Seattle's Chinatown neighborhood.

items.h: Seattle attorney's lawsuit alleges airlines inflated fares
items.sum: A Seattle attorney is suing Alaska Airlines, Delta and others, alleging the carriers coordinated to raise fares.
